basic_info.description: Attention all Corporate clients just relocating to San Francisco or working on a project in San Francisco. Fantastic two bedroom, two bath, Condo/Home in Telegraph and very private. Nestled in a area that has privacy but feels like you are in cabin. Floor to ceiling Windows in the living room, patio off the living room and Very large patio/deck off the second bedroom/office. Beautiful upgraded kitchen with top of the line appliance. Pet friendly-15 pound max. Place included one garage and right on Chestnut and Grant in Telegraph Hill. Beautiful area and right next to Russian Hill and Ferry Buildings, Financial District. Great place and it is available to rent furnished only for one year lease or sooner. A jewel and VERY nice.
